# Clandest Agency

> Clandest Agency is a design, development, and video post-production studio based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, founded by four diploma graduates from Munshiganj Polytechnic Institute. Direct founder access, zero middlemen, 100% commercial ownership.

Website: https://clandestagency.vercel.app
Email: clandest.agency@gmail.com
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8801869504388 (+880 1869 504388)
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh

## Core Services & Disciplines

- [Marketing Video Post-Production](https://clandestagency.vercel.app/services#video): High-converting Video Sales Letters (VSLs), short-form UGC ads (9:16 for TikTok/Reels), documentary narratives, motion graphics in After Effects, studio audio mastering, and color grading. Led by Abdullah Al Rafayet.
- [Logo & Brand Identity Design](https://clandestagency.vercel.app/services#branding): Vector master assets (.SVG, .AI, .PDF), comprehensive Figma design systems, color tokens, typography scales, social kits, and 100% commercial copyright. Led by Sadman Zaman Khan.
- [Website Redesign & Frontend Development](https://clandestagency.vercel.app/services#development): Ultra-fast, clean React + TypeScript web applications, zero bloated plugins, Core Web Vitals optimization, full GitHub repo ownership, and production Vercel deployment. Led by Md Nafiur Rahman.

## The Founding Team

- Sadman Zaman Khan: UI/UX & Brand Design (Munshiganj Polytechnic, European IT Solutions industrial attachment)
- Md. Habibullah: Operations & Client Relations (Munshiganj Polytechnic, client coordination & delivery)
- Abdullah Al Rafayet: Head of Video & Motion (Munshiganj Polytechnic, European IT Solutions attachment, commercial video editing)
- Md Nafiur Rahman: Lead Frontend Engineer (Munshiganj Polytechnic, Rover Scouts Senior Rover Mate, web architecture)

## How We Work (4-Step Process)

1. We talk: Direct consultation to define scope, timeline, and a fixed quote.
2. We design: Interactive Figma prototypes, high-fidelity brand concepts, and video storyboards.
3. We build: Clean, lightweight TypeScript code and cinematic post-production video editing.
4. We launch: DNS setup, live Vercel deployment, and handoff of all raw master files with 100% ownership.
